name: Balu Forge Industries Limited
summary: Balu Forge Industries Limited manufactures and sells crankshafts in India and internationally. It offers bombshell, stainless steel flanges, valve components, stub ends, forged hydraulic fittings, railway wheels, axles, wheel sets, swan necks, flange balls, tow bar, sorting, snap, shank, ramshorn lifting hooks, hub, brake flange, disc, caliper, rotor, track, body and piston brakes, front axle beams, steering knuckles, control arm, fork, steering, drive shafts, input and output shafts, main shafts, yokes, track shoe, track link, track roller, carries roller, sprocket, track chain, idler, turbine blade, and empty shells.
